title: SQL Server: a dropped capture instance loses a change without an error

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, two runs

symptom: After sp_cdc_disable_table on the capture instance, two updates COMPLETED with no error event, and a changed row didn't arrive. After CDC was re-enabled, a full refresh of the table delivered the row.
cause: Not established. The gateway log wasn't read.
effect: A change is lost until a full refresh.
fix: Full refresh the table after changing its capture instance.
notes: A change-tracking setup on a CDC table and a filegroup move also gave no error event in one run.
